#### Assumption 2: Homogeneous random network interference

We make the assumption that interference runs only along the random [network graph](#def-graph) $\mathbf \Psi_s$, or not at all (the empty graph $\mathbf 0$): each structural equation depends on other units' variables only through their network values in the graph shown.


$$
\begin{aligned}
&  f_{\mathbf R_s}    & &\text{depends only on network values in} &  \mathbf{\Psi}_{s}\\
&  f_{\mathbf T_s}      & &\text{depends only on network values in} &  \mathbf{0}\\
&  f_{\mathbf M_s}      & &\text{depends only on network values in} &  \mathbf{\Psi}_{s}\\
&  f_{\mathbf V_s}      & &\text{depends only on network values in} &  \mathbf{0}\\
\end{aligned}
$$
